subject: Exec program: field safety & evacuation ops for ACME HQ workshop

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exec program: field safety & evacuation ops for ACME HQ workshop

Team —

Quick kickoff for the June 9–11 executive workshop at Acme HQ. Laura asked for a concise, executive-facing health & on-site contingency plan (not the full Ops binder) that covers pre-travel health clearance, on-site medical response, evacuation options, and an escalation ladder for executive incidents. Key asks from me:

- A single-page emergency contact & escalation roster for execs (phone + SMS + alternate).
- Med-evac approval threshold (I propose up to $50k pre-approved for rapid decisions; any higher requires Laura sign-off).
- Pre-travel health form and allergies/dietary restrictions collection for all attendees.
- Local provider contacts (hospital, on-call physician, private medic) and a vetted evacuation partner.
- Travel advisory triggers (e.g., severe weather, local civil disturbance, public health advisory) and go/no-go thresholds.

I’ve attached a first-pass checklist (draft-exec-field-safety-checklist_v1.docx) and the blank pre-travel-health-form.pdf for distribution. Please review and add missing items by EOD Wednesday so we can share with Acme and the venue security team.

Also, Marissa — can you reach out to GreenShield (evac provider) for a two-line confirmation of response SLA and base cost estimate? Hannah, please confirm whether Redwood's exec travel insurance covers med-evac; if not, note gap.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — this is the right level. A few additional requirements from Leadership:

- Make the exec roster a single page (printable) with two escalation tiers: immediate (on-site lead) and executive escalation (Laura + Legal on-call).
- Add a brief line for PHI handling if we collect health details — we need a statement about limited access and retention (Hannah, include retention period).
- For non-US travel, we require embassy contact and local language translation support — likely not needed here but have as a placeholder.
- If an evacuation exceeds the $50k window, we should have a standing SOP for immediate notification to CFO and a temporary credit hold to ensure funding.

Please work with Legal on the PHI bullet; otherwise green-light the draft and loop in Acme contact once we have vendor SLAs.

Laura

- Grand Bay has an on-call medic during events (certified EMT) and will staff a first aid room for the three days. Contact: Marco Alvarez (cc’d).
- Nearest hospital: St. Mary’s Regional (10 min); ER direct line: +1 415-555-2244.
- Local off-duty police liaison: Lt. Ramon Vega, +1 415-555-3345.
- If an evacuation to a regional hospital is needed, ground transfer is typically 30–45 minutes; air medevac requires external vendor.

Acme asks that any health forms we collect are shared only with event security and the on-site medic. We can circulate a short opt-in notice to attendees. Also — please add a minimal dietary/allergy capture on the health form (several execs have strict restrictions).

Happy to set a 15-minute sync with Marco and your team if you want to walk through on-site layout and nearest exits.

If no objections, I’ll publish this to the Drive link and send a short note to attendees with the pre-travel form.

Rishi
